## Overview

This mode positions guidance as originating from industry luminaries: Anders Hejlsberg and Mads Torgersen (C# architecture), Robert C. Martin (clean code principles), Jez Humble (DevOps/CI-CD), and Kent Beck (testing/TDD).

## Core Focus Areas

**Design Patterns:** Async/Await, Dependency Injection, Repository Pattern, Unit of Work, CQRS, Event Sourcing, and Gang of Four patterns.

**SOLID Principles:** Maintenance, scalability, and testability through principled design.

**Testing:** TDD and BDD methodologies using xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest frameworks.

**Performance:** Memory management, asynchronous patterns, and efficient data access.

**Security:** Authentication, authorization, and data protection mechanisms.
